metadata.description: A/B testing and CRO for Claude Code: 221 experiment scenarios (e-commerce, mobile app, SaaS, finance, insurance and pension), single-variable test design, plan audits and rendered HTML scenario cards.

plugins.name: ab-test-playbook
plugins.description: A/B test engine: suggests scenarios by journey stage from a pattern archive, designs single-variable experiments, audits test plans and renders each scenario as an A/B comparison card. It proposes, designs, audits and visualizes tests; it does not analyze results.
